messages.text: Your cookware set order is still marked as shipped, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process yet. Refunds are available only for delivered orders (refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders), and the shop must have received the item back before it can refund it (refund-policy/v1/return). Once it’s delivered and returned, you can ask us to check the refund.
What can I do while it’s still on the way?
